actions.text: Referred to the Committee on Education and Workforce, and in addition to the Committee on Ways and Means, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

Referred to the Committee on Education and Workforce, and in addition to the Committee on Ways and Means, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

dimensions.assessment: Affects public service employees (first responders, educators, and social workers) with long careers and their college-aged dependents.
dimensions.evidence: to provide educational assistance to each dependent of each public service employee who, on or after the effective date of this Act, has at least 20 years of service

dimensions.assessment: Significant financial assistance covering tuition, fees, and books at public postsecondary institutions for up to 4 academic years.
dimensions.evidence: shall be in an amount that covers the cost of tuition, fees, and books for a program of study at an applicable postsecondary educational institution

dimensions.assessment: Federal funding for educational assistance program grants, tax exemption for assistance provided, with no effect on retirement benefits.
dimensions.evidence: Educational assistance provided under this Act shall be exempt from taxation under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986.

dimensions.assessment: Creates a new federal educational assistance program administered by the Department of Education.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall establish a Public Service Educational Assistance Program to provide educational assistance

dimensions.assessment: Ongoing permanent program providing benefits for up to 4 years per eligible dependent, taking effect one year after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: This Act shall take effect on the date that is 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Total projected cost and annual federal budget outlays for the educational assistance program.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the Secretary of Education to establish a Public Service Educational Assistance Program providing tuition, fee, and book coverage for up to 4 academic years to dependents of public service employees with at least 20 years of service.
